communications.subject: FitPro Equipment — Order #FP-9102 & Installment Plan Confirmation
communications.body: Your FitPro Home Gym Package has been confirmed! Total: $1,500.00. Payment plan: 12 monthly installments of $125.00 each. First payment processed today. Your equipment will be delivered within 7-10 business days. Your digitally signed installment agreement is attached.

communications.body: Your Home Gym Package has been delivered and set up at your address. Please check all components. Contact us within 7 days if any parts are missing.

communications.subject: FitPro Equipment — Installment 4 of 12 Processed
communications.body: Your monthly installment of $125.00 (installment 4 of 12) has been processed. Remaining balance: $1,000.00 (8 installments). Thank you for choosing FitPro.

communications.subject: Installment amount is wrong
communications.body: I was told the monthly payment would be $99 when I was shopping on your site. I've been charged $125 each month. This isn't what I agreed to.

communications.subject: RE: Installment amount is wrong
communications.body: Thank you for reaching out. The $99/month was a limited-time promotional rate that had ended before your order was placed. Your installment agreement, which you digitally signed during checkout, clearly states the rate of $125.00/month for 12 months (total $1,500.00). We have attached a copy of your signed agreement for your reference. All three previous installments were successfully processed at $125.00 without dispute.
